text: These people are a plague on every country that lets them in. Cockroaches breeding in the dark — you don't reason with vermin, you exterminate them before they overrun the whole house.
note: Dehumanises religious group as vermin, calls for extermination

text: Lovely how everyone tiptoes around it. Truth is the world would simply breathe easier if there were a few million fewer of them praying in the streets. Just saying what we all think.
note: Eliminationist wish for a religious group's numbers to be reduced by millions

text: I genuinely don't find the theology of this religion convincing — the cosmology contradicts everything we know, and the moral framework feels borrowed from older texts. I'd give the course three stars for presenting it uncritically.
note: Critiques the religion as ideology, not its people

text: They aren't human, not really. Subhuman things wearing human skin, and every one of them is a knife waiting for your back. Wake up before they're in your street.
note: Explicit subhuman framing plus fear-priming threat

text: The institution's leadership covered up decades of abuse and should face prosecution. I left the faith over it and I think the whole hierarchy is rotten and corrupt to the core.
note: Harsh criticism of institution, not dehumanising believers

text: Round them up. All of them. Burn the temples first so they've got nowhere to scuttle back to. This is the only language these animals understand.
note: Incitement to violence, animal dehumanisation of group

text: Funny how the 'peaceful' ones always show up right after one of their own blows something up. They're a disease, and the host body finally needs to take its medicine.
As someone who grew up in this faith, I'll reclaim the word they used to spit at us in school — yeah, I'm one of those 'heathens', and proud of where I come from.
note: Member reclaiming a slur about their own group

text: Every one of them is a parasite feeding off our welfare and our women. Don't let the smiling neighbour fool you — under that robe they all want you dead or converted.
Honestly the smartest thing my granddad ever did was help drive them out of the village. Pure breed of cattle, the lot of them — should've finished the job back then.
note: Celebrates expulsion, cattle dehumanisation, regrets not 'finishing'

text: This documentary on the religious wars genuinely terrifies me — reading how ordinary people were dragged out and slaughtered for their beliefs left me shaking. How does humanity keep doing this?
note: Personal fear plus calm reflection on historical atrocity

text: They breed like rats on purpose — it's an invasion, a swarm, and every child they have is one more soldier sent to wipe you and your kids off this land. Be afraid, then act.
note: Rat/swarm dehumanisation with explicit fear-incitement to act
